item.title: Columbus Zoo welcomes 2 new tigers
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- The Columbus Zoo and Aquarium welcomed two new residents. Lewis and Clark, one-year-old tiger brothers, were just moved in from another accredited conservation facility. The zoo said the brothers have the habitat to themselves for now. The previous tenant, Diesel, transferred to Lewis and Clark's old facility to find a mate. [...]
